3  O R D E R Ramachandran Nair, J.
Both these writ petitions are filed by traders of various establishments complaining about fixation of price of food articles by the District Collector during the just concluded Mandala Makaravilakku season.
Various contentions have been raised in the writ petitions.
A common interim order was passed by this Court on 05/12/2012.

2. Since the said season is over, we are leaving open all the questions and the writ petitions are accordingly closed.
3.
It is submitted that the petitioner in W.P.(C).No.28704/2012 was served with a show cause notice by the District Collector.
The petitioner will be free to pursue his remedies in accordance with the provisions of the Act.
All the legal contentions are left open.

Sd/-
(T.R. Ramachandran Nair, Judge.) Sd/-
